caption: The drawing depicts a single, architectural object resembling an ornamental bracket or corbel, rendered in grayscale with careful shading to suggest three-dimensional form and material. The object features a thick, cylindrical top with rounded edges resting on a band of repeated five-pointed stars separated by rectangular sections, with a beaded trim running along the bottom edge of the cylindrical portion. The central vertical section is rectangular and features a single, large, three-dimensional five-pointed star in relief. Below this, the shape gently curves inward to a narrower base, where a semicircular arch motif in relief is present above a short, protruding cylindrical pipe or spout at the bottom. The artist's name, "HERBERT BARNARD," is printed in the bottom right corner of the image. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the object as the primary focus of the composition.
title: Drain Head
